reviewer: Independent Codex reviewer; writes confined to review evidence; no game or asset edits
score_scope: Repository publication rubric; visual+1 reflects changed main silhouettes and coherent placement. Not commercial-art parity or a child-satisfaction percentage.

score_rationale.curriculum: Unchanged grade5 rectangle-area inverse problem tied to field height and harvested box count.
score_rationale.math: Math SHA unchanged,20 core functions identical and1 changed only icon cache suffix. All80 final Korean QA samples independently recalculated with BigInt.
score_rationale.fun: Resize, growth, brush harvest, cart delivery and persistent farm growth verified by full actual-input campaign. Repeated inverse-problem structure remains.
score_rationale.visual: Projecting porch, deeper roof, curved market awning, asymmetric apple canopy with branch gaps and three carrot stage meshes visibly differ from v2. Path placement and lighting also improve. Small planning field, short sprout exposure, shared tree geometry and simple shadows remain.
score_rationale.mobile: All144 crop points within and unblocked at320/390/820/1280 widths. Actual390 touch harvest and1280 real Tab focus release pass; no low-end physical phone data.

strengths: Main building, tree and carrot silhouettes changed while preserving teal, cream and timber styling.
Same original models demonstrate part hiding, recolor and scale changes in farm and village-market layouts.
Actual UI verified144-cell harvest, error recovery, duplicate prevention and persistence.

qualitative_visual_comparison.verdict: verified modest-to-clear improvement, strongest in enlarged buildings and tree silhouettes
improvements: Farmhouse has a projecting gabled porch, thick supports and eaves with clearer roof mass.
Market stall has a curved awning, rounded edge and separated produce display.
Apple tree has differently sized canopy lobes, visible forked branches and large fruit.
Carrot uses distinct sprout, young and mature GLB meshes during real growth.
Wheel tracks, path borders, low leaf clusters and moderated lighting organize the setting.
remaining_gaps: Planning plot remains small within broad scenery.
Sprout is a tiny dot at approximately0.11s; full growth lasts about1.14s, limiting appreciation of three stages.
Tree variations use the same parts with scale/fruit visibility changes, not three different base meshes.
Building details are less prominent at390px than enlarged studio images.
qualitative_visual_comparison.comparison_limit: Personally viewed v2 and final runtime captures and final model studio images. No matched old/new studio camera-lighting A/B provided; whole-scene improvements cannot all be assigned to model geometry.

math_verification.inherited_only: Previous99+1 item pool,3400 predicates,5000 campaigns/40000 ordinary questions and2000 samples reused only after exact math SHA and core-state comparison; not rerun in v3.

mistake_tolerance.actual_path: Ordinary24-box order at width6m: wrong height5m gives30m2, then actual touch correction to4m. Nine-order actual touch campaign completed.

maximum_count.scope: Disclosed seed2 random stream supplies normal campaign with144 cells at round8; no answer/state injection. Visible quantities solved independently. All four capacity widths retained isMobile:true to avoid Puppeteer reload; official QA separately measures native desktop emulation at1280.
maximum_count.duplicate_tap: First6 harvested remain6 after repeated same touch; score/coins unchanged until delivery.

firstplay.scope: 45-second scripted pointer probe; all 16 captured frames personally viewed. Probe excludes links leaving the game and uses Apple M4 GPU. Not a naive-player test.
firstplay.final_observation: Still tutorial1/9, hearts2, width4m/height2m/order12boxes. Feedback correctly says8m2 and4boxes short.
firstplay.comprehensible: Visible rule, order, dimensions and corrective feedback verified; spontaneous solution and child comprehension unproven.

qa_summary.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)

asset_reuse.evidence: 12 embedded GLBs, named structural components/anchors,31-entry ZIP CRC and GLB/runtime byte identity pass. Two rendered layouts show part hiding, recoloring and size variation; unrelated-game runtime portability not tested.
asset_reuse.visual_remake_scope: Four main asset identities remade; two carrot stage assets added. Other binary changes include re-export/optimization and are not counted as distinct visual redesigns.

limitations: No observed child usability or satisfaction study.
Apple M4 GPU browser emulation does not establish low-end phone performance.
Firstplay remained on tutorial; controlled completion does not prove spontaneous discovery.
Tree variants share base geometry; two reuse presets do not prove integration in an unrelated game.
nice_to_have: Give small carrot stages longer visual exposure.
Develop additional tree base shapes and softer layered contact shadows.
